summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK TR-1 major holdings notification (the US equivalent of a Schedule 13G-style stake disclosure) after Royal Bank of Canada and its controlled undertakings crossed a threshold. RBC's aggregate voting position fell to 2.9900895% (4,400,255 votes) from a prior 3.880230%, with the change dated 9-Oct-2026 and notified 15-Oct-2026. The decrease results from an acquisition or disposal of voting rights, all held directly in shares (2.9309653% ordinary, 0.0591242% US-listed line), with no financial instruments. No board recommendation or advisor is stated; watch further crossing notices.
